dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region displaying high-contrast transitions from dark outer perimeters to high-intensity centers with jagged, non-uniform edge boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the lower lateral margin and the posterior extremity, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral with the long axis parallel to the dorsal curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-contrast, linear striations appearing as vertical bands at the transition point between the dorsal torso and the head region.
